Class NetpbmInput

java.lang.Object
bg.tu_varna.sit.cs.f24621858.image.inputOutput.ImageInput
bg.tu_varna.sit.cs.f24621858.image.inputOutput.NetpbmInput
All Implemented Interfaces:
FileInput
Direct Known Subclasses:
NetpbmInputStream, NetpbmReader
public abstract class NetpbmInput extends ImageInput
Abstract Template Method implementation for reading Netpbm image files.

The abstract method getPixels(FileInputStream, NetpbmFormatImage) is the only step that differs between ASCII (NetpbmReader) and binary (NetpbmInputStream) formats. All other steps are identical and are handled here.

Author:
Dmitro Dashchenko

      public int[][][] readBody(FileInputStream fileImageStream) throws EOFException, IOException, InvalidImageDataException
      Validates image parameters and delegates pixel reading to getPixels(FileInputStream, NetpbmFormatImage).
